title: HustleBox v1.0.0 — Welcome to the Block
message:
First version of HustleBox is live. You're Marcus, 19, fresh off the eviction bus with $12 in your pocket. Uncle Ray gave you a shot at his food truck on 5th and Main. Now grind.

• Food Truck mini-game playable — tap ingredients in order to fill orders before the timer runs out
• Stacks wallet with idle income (your wages tick up while you're working the truck)
• Reputation system — 0 to 100, affects customer flow and tips
• Rank progression — Broke → Hustler → Grinder → Player → Boss → Legend
• Update Log screen (you're reading it)
• Basic Settings screen — sound, vibration, motion toggles
• Friend code generated for your account (Friends tab coming in a future update)

More jobs, the back room arcade, and friends features all on the way.
